title: Student demonstrations in Santiago and Valparaíso over restricted TNE use
scope: Students protested the Comptroller’s interpretation limiting the National Student Card to school-related travel; each city is a distinct local occurrence, with no count reported.
organizer: Confederation of Chilean Students (Confech); local organizers otherwise unknown.
participants_original: Unknown; no turnout count stated in the article.
threshold_50_evidence: Opened Cooperativa report confirms separate demonstrations in Santiago and Valparaíso but gives no attendance count at either. Do not aggregate sites to claim >=50 at one gathering.

start_date.summary: The report dates the demonstrations to Friday, Aug. 8, 2025.

location.summary: Students in Santiago and Valparaíso protested; separate local attendance remains unquantified.

scope.summary: Opposed restriction of the TNE to trips for study.

organizer.summary: Confech issued the quoted demand; other city organizers unknown.

state_target.summary: Confech directed demands to the Transport and Education ministries and the Government of Chile.

demand.summary: Amend Decree 20 of 1982 to secure universal, unrestricted, free student travel.

state_response.summary: Government response to demonstrations not covered in the article.

state_target: Government of Chile; Ministry of Transport and Telecommunications; Ministry of Education.
notes: No count for either site. RED driver/food-handler stoppages are distinct labour activity and are not merged into this event.
open_questions: What was attendance at each city gathering?
Did either ministry change the TNE rule in response?
